title: Asset
description: A deduplicated REAL-WORLD THING: one specific pothole on one specific stretch of road, assembled by multi-pass evidence fusion from every Observation the fleet has ever made of it. This is the only defect object a dashboard, a work order or an API consumer ever sees. Assets are produced by the backend, never by the edge. Direction of travel is downstream only: backend -> frontend over REST and WebSocket.

state.description: Lifecycle. candidate: seen, not yet corroborated. confirmed: independently observed by >= K distinct buses. reported: a work order was issued. resolved: the fleet STOPPED seeing it across N qualifying passes, so the repair verified itself. rejected: an operator marked it a false positive, which feeds back as a hard negative for retraining. stale: no qualifying pass in 30 days, so the platform declines to assert anything.

geo.description: Inverse-variance weighted centroid across all contributing observations. Positional error shrinks roughly as 1/sqrt(N): a single pass is +/-6 m, twelve passes are under +/-2 m.

confidence.description: Fused belief, accumulated in log-odds across independent observations and weighted by per-device reliability and capture conditions. Three mediocre 0.70 detections from three different buses outrank one isolated 0.95.

distinct_devices.description: Number of DIFFERENT edge units that saw it. The corroboration that matters. Forty sightings from one bus is one bus's opinion.

negative_passes.description: Qualifying passes that inspected this location for this class and found nothing. Drives auto-resolution.

score.description: Median of per-observation severity. Median, not mean, so one badly-ranged observation cannot drag the figure.

trend.description: Theil-Sen slope of severity over time. A pothole widening week on week is a different priority from a stable one, and only a repeatedly-passing fleet can tell you which it is.

surface_damage_pct.description: For damaged_road: percentage of segment surface area classified as distressed. The engineering metric, analogous to a Pavement Condition Index input. Counting individual cracks is not.

canonical_evidence.description: The single best crop across all observations, selected by sharpness x illumination x subject size. The fleet effectively photographs each defect dozens of times and the platform keeps the best frame.

evidence_gallery.description: Up to 6 crops spread across time, so an engineer can see deterioration rather than a single moment.

work_order.description: The municipal hand-off. This is what turns a detection into evidence-based decision making.

recommended_action.description: Class-specific, from the taxonomy in docs/02. Example: raise patching work order to ward engineer.
examples: Raise patching work order to ward engineer

ledger.description: Present only for missing_* classes, which are never emitted by the edge. It records the map-difference reasoning that concluded something expected is absent, so the conclusion is auditable rather than asserted.

expected_from.description: osm: the map says a crossing belongs at this junction. historical_observation: the fleet used to see it and no longer does.
